About Jennifers Eden

Every detail, styled with intention.

Jennifers Eden specialises in luxury artificial floral installations, event styling and premium party hire across Gloucestershire and Oxfordshire. From breathtaking flower arches and bespoke venue styling to elegant soft play and party décor, we create unforgettable spaces for the moments that matter most.

No two events are alike, and neither are our installations — every arch, backdrop and soft play suite is designed around your day, your palette and your venue.
